text:
Lucy (PM): Quick request — webinar next Wed. Need a set of benchmark visuals for launch: hero slide + social tiles + micro-tiles + a sparkline animation. Deadline EOD Tue. Can design pick this up?

Jamal (Design): Got it — can take. Need copy and the benchmark numbers. Also any existing templates to follow? :+1:

Lucy (PM): Copy draft below and I'll attach the sheet. Metric callouts: median latency 12ms, cost $0.016/token, throughput 120 req/s. Messaging options A/B in the doc. Short CTA: "Try the benchmark".

Anna (Marketing): Heads up — need alternate headline variants for socials: 1) "Inference that scales" 2) "Latency you can promise" 3) "Cost-aware inference". Prefer #2. Also want a darker hero variant for LinkedIn.

Jamal (Design): Cool. Can you drop the copy into the folder? Also upload any example style tiles. Export specs I'm planning to follow: 
```
Hero: 3840x2160 @72dpi (png + jpg)
Social square: 1200x1200 (png)
Micro-tile: 600x314 (png)
Sparkline: 1200x675 gif, 3s loop
Colors: brand palette v2
Fonts: Inter Variable
```

Chris (Creative Ops): I'll create a staging folder: /marketing/launchs/benchmarks/170925 and share links. Need source Figma link + a copy deck. Also confirm localization — do we need UK/EU variants?

Maria (Growth): For inbound routing set UTM params: utm_campaign=bench-launch&utm_medium=social&utm_source=organic. When assets go live add lead tag `bench-webinar-170925` so LP form maps leads to the campaign. I'll add routing to the marketing automation once assets are up.

Jamal (Design): Uploading first pass to the folder in a few hours. Asking for any legal/brand check now — cc @BrandBot

BrandBot: Brand compliance scan complete: primary palette usage OK. Contrast check: hero-dark fails AA for body text. Recommend increasing text weight or lightening background by 8%.

Jamal (Design): Thanks — I'll tweak hero-dark to pass contrast. Will provide both light and dark variants. ETA for first pass: tomorrow 11:00am PST.

Lucy (PM): Perfect. If anything blocks you tag me. I'll drop the final numbers and the copy doc in this thread and add the webinar registration link when ready. :rocket:
